//: Added 2026-08-08 so `shadcn add` could resolve the `@/*` alias while installing
Dither Kit. The project is JavaScript and Vite compiles the handful of .tsx
files it already had (components/ui/*.tsx) without ever needing this — nothing
type-checks against it. It exists to satisfy tooling that reads paths from
tsconfig rather than from vite.config.js, and `allowJs` + `checkJs: false` keep
it from asserting anything about the .js that makes up the rest of the app.
